info.title: Construction Site Management System
info.description: REST API for the Construction Site Management System. Manages labour, attendance, expenses, warehouse inventory, and purchase activity across construction sites.

post.description: Authenticate user by phone & password and issue access + refresh tokens.
Validate refresh token and issue a fresh access token and refresh token pair.
Create a new Admin or Supervisor account (Admin only).

get.description: List all registered user accounts with pagination (Admin only).
Get user details by ID (Admin can view any user; Supervisor can view only self).

patch.description: Update user profile fields (Admin can update any user; Supervisor can update only self).

delete.description: Deactivate a user account by setting is_active = False (Admin only).

patch.description: Reactivate a user account by setting is_active = True (Admin only).

post.description: Register a new worker with full name and daily wage (Admin only).

get.description: List all worker accounts with pagination (Admin and Supervisor). Filter by active status using ?is_active=true or ?is_active=false. When omitted, returns all workers.

parameters.name: is_active

schema.description: Filter workers by active status. When omitted, returns all workers.
schema.title: Is Active

parameters.description: Filter workers by active status. When omitted, returns all workers.

get.description: Get worker details by ID (Admin and Supervisor). Returns active and inactive workers.

patch.description: Update worker full name or daily wage rate (Admin only).

delete.description: Deactivate a worker account by setting is_active = False (Admin only).

patch.description: Reactivate a worker account by setting is_active = True (Admin only).

get.description:
Return service health status.

Used by load balancers and monitoring systems.
Always returns 200 while the process is alive.

driver_type.description: Driver sub-type; null for non-driver accounts.

DriverType.title: DriverType
DriverType.description:
Sub-type that differentiates the three driver roles.

Only meaningful when ``Users.role == UserRole.DRIVER``.
Design ref: CSMS_SPEC.md §5 User Roles.
